deals.description: September is the time to financially recover from costly summer breaks…& luckily it’s also the time of a TON of free Vienna events! ⬇️ 🚨 Free = free entry! Obviously for most events consuming food or drink will cost. Ok, here’s your free Vienna events guide for September 2026: 🍎Lange Nacht der Wiener Märkte | 4 Sept Vienna markets host an exciting night program - art, music and more! ☕️Barista Cup (1070) | 4 Sept Organized by Julius Meinl, there’s interactive stations and free coffee! 🎷Remasuri - Strassenfest der Wollzeile (1010) | 5 Sept Music, readings, and lots of stalls to browse! 🎥VOLXkino (around Vienna) | until 19 Sept volxkino_wien Free open air cinema! 🎤Reindorfgassenfest (1150) | 11 - 12 Sept A street festival with live music and DJ sets! 🚒Wiener Feuerwehrfest (1010) | 11 - 13 Sept Kids obsessed with fire trucks (like mine!) will love this! 🍻Ottakinger Kirtag | 11 - 13 Sept Live music, fun fair rides, and food & beer stands! 📚 Literaturmeile Zieglergasse (1070) | 12 Sept literaturmeile A packed schedule with readings, workshops and children’s programming! 🌾 ernte.dank.festival (1010) | 12 - 13 Sept oekosozialesforum Celebrate the harvest season in the city center. 🎺 WähringerStraßenFest (1180) | 18 Sept September is really street festival season! ☀️ Josefstädter Strassenfest (1080) | 18 Sept Love music, shopping & more! 🌱 Veganmania (1210) | 18 - 20 Sept vegane_gesellschaft Austria’s biggest vegan street food festival. 🗑️Mistfest (1170) | 19 - 20 Sept die48er MA48 hosts a large event with a flea market, info stands, and more! 🏢Open House Vienna | 25 - 27 Sept open_house_wien Tour Vienna buildings not normally open to the public! 🚋Tag des Denkmals | 27 Sept tagdesdenkmals.at Heritage Day means many museums are open for free, there’s rides around t
